# LochViewer

> LochViewer is a modern web-based 3D speleological viewer for cave surveys (.lox, .3d, .plt), digital elevation models (DMR 5.0), and massive LiDAR point clouds (.ply, .las).

## Key Features
- Dual-Engine 3D Rendering (Engine v1 for mesh & survey networks, Engine v2 for massive LiDAR LOD)
- Official Slovak Geodetic Institute (GKÚ ZBGIS) DMR 5.0 and WMS integration
- Eye-Dome Lighting (EDL), clipping planes, cross-sections, and speleological measurements
